SELECT u.user_id, COUNT(*) AS n, AVG(o.total_amount) AS avg_total
FROM users u JOIN orders_0 o ON o.user_id = u.user_id
WHERE o.created_at >= '2026-01-01' AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
GROUP BY u.user_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ORDER BY avg_total DESC LIMIT 20;
